summary: Word Pronunciation is a pronunciation API that retrieves the phonetic pronunciation of any English word in ARPAbet format.
description:
Word Pronunciation is a pronunciation API that retrieves the phonetic pronunciation of any English word in ARPAbet format. Pass a word to receive its phonetic transcription for speech synthesis, dictionaries, or language tools.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Word Pronunciation from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
